name: InvStorage — ERPNext Order Sync (Phase 1: Shadow Ledger)

nodes.name: Get Order from Medusa
nodes.notes:
SETUP REQUIRED: Configure Medusa HTTP Header Auth credential with:
Name: Authorization
Value: Bearer <medusa_admin_token>

nodes.name: Lookup Customer
nodes.notes: Checks if customer already exists in ERPNext by email.

parameters.jsonBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ customer_name: $json.customer_name, customer_type: 'Individual', customer_group: 'Individual', territory: 'All Territories', email_id: $json.customer_email }) }}

={{ JSON.stringify({ customer: $json.erpnext_customer, currency: $json.currency?.toUpperCase() || 'USD', items: $json.items?.map(i => ({ item_code: i.item_code, item_name: i.item_name, qty: i.qty, rate: i.rate })) || [], custom_medusa_order_id: $json.order_id, posting_date: ($json.created_at || '').substring(0,10) || undefined, update_stock: 1 }) }}

nodes.name: Create Sales Invoice
nodes.notes: Creates a Sales Invoice in ERPNext. This automatically deducts stock in ERPNext's shadow inventory and records the revenue (update_stock=1).
